1.d4 Nf6 2.c4 e6 3.g3 c5 4.d5.strategy: Gains space and fixes the centre at once, aiming at an unbalanced pawn structure. White holds the central pawns and may later push e4, while Black counters with a queenside majority and an open e-file.

1.d4 Nf6 2.c4 e6 3.g3 c5 4.d5 exd5.strategy: Takes the pawn and opens the e-file against the pawn on e2. Black gives up the solid centre for activity: after the recapture White has the d5 pawn and central space, and Black plays for the queenside majority.
